key_facts: The X7 is at technology readiness level 5, with the company targeting TRL 6 in early 2027, and no contracts have been awarded.
The X7 uses a ground control station ingesting sensor data via the SAPIENT communications standard, allowing it to take targeting information from any external sensor network.
OM Defence Systems tested the X7 ground control station at NATO's TIE26 exercise (May 11-22) and BATT26 event in Latvia (Aug. 4-14).
The X7 operated in full autonomous mode at TRL 5 during field demonstrations with the British Army in March 2026.
OM Defence Systems reported production of 500 Shadow systems in 2025, with plans for 1,500 in 2026, for use by the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
